buildCommand:
ROOT=.
if [ ! -f scripts/build-ipv4-data.mjs ]; then
  if [ -f ../scripts/build-ipv4-data.mjs ]; then
    ROOT=..
  else
    ROOT=../..
  fi
fi
cd "$ROOT" && pnpm --filter @ipmap/types build && node scripts/build-ipv4-data.mjs && node scripts/build-infra-data.mjs && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=450 pnpm --filter @ipmap/web build
